reason: VALUE lens: no real private gain. (a) The hidden set is fixed and processed in one run; #35 (same insertion, ungated) already finished in <= 7.73 h on the full public+private set (step0.md), and K2 ~= #35 + a few s/clip, so P(K2-family > 8.0 h) is driven only by hardware variance (~0.03-0.1). (b) Ceiling from the metric: insertion is worth +0.001 on the LB (one probe, 3-decimal display, true delta 0..0.002), i.e. ~+0.01 of 0.1 x division Jaccard; losing it on 5-15% of clips costs 0.00005-0.00015, times P gives EV ~2e-6..1.5e-5, far below private noise and never rank-changing. (c) K2 is frozen for 00:00 UTC with passing dummies, so D4 can only ride on K3. K3's score comes from its own single hidden run, and its latency is visible before finals are ticked (latency > 8 h = possible partial insertion), so the two final picks already hedge the risk. (d) Part 2 (gate 8.0 -> 9.5 h) can be NET NEGATIVE in exactly the slow world it insures. Each insertion adds 66-185 s/clip and pushes later clips past the 9.5 h repair deadline, where they lose relink/gap repair, which is worth far more per clip than insertion. The v3 plan chose 8.0 h on purpose (FINAL_REPORT l.57). (e) Part 1's savings are unverified. U (tracked nodes with one out-edge) and C1 (their children, usually parents at t+1) overlap heavily (div_insert.py l.170-179), so the unique-parent stage is probably most of nodes_scored, not ~1/3. Changing the scored set also changes the score_nodes batch composition (daughternet.py l.125-130), which risks cuDNN float drift at the 0.4 threshold and cap ordering, so the sha256 gate may fail after 2-3 h of work. (f) The freed runtime is worth ~0: there is already ~4 h of headroom under the 12 h limit, and no approved rider needs it (R8/R9). Not a closed line and not a node-count artefact, but the EV is ~1e-5 and can be negative.
fix: Do not build D4. Keep DIVINS_DEADLINE_S = 28,800 in K2 and K3. Instead, log K2's observed latency (poll.log): if it is <= 8.0 h, insertion provably ran on every clip and the question is closed. If a K3 rider adds a lot of runtime, re-run the step-0 arithmetic for that rider and gate it, rather than touching the insertion. Revisit only if K2/K3 latency is > 7.9 h. Even then, prefer the constant change alone (--set DIVINS_DEADLINE_S, no new code), and only with a repair-first ordering argument showing that the insertion cannot push clips past the 9.5 h repair deadline.
realistic_gain: ~0 (EV about +2e-6..+1.5e-5 private for K3 only; 0 for K2; part 2 can be negative in the >9 h world). Cost: 2-3 agent hours + ~25 min GPU + new code in a final.
